business_problem: VNPT needed a high-performance traffic-monitoring system that could analyze thousands of camera feeds and hundreds of thousands of AI service requests to improve congestion management and road safety at busy intersections.
solution_summary: VNPT AI built a traffic-monitoring platform on NVIDIA AI Enterprise so it could analyze thousands of camera feeds and handle hundreds of thousands of AI service requests across busy Vietnamese intersections. Video streams are ingested through NVIDIA Metropolis and the NVIDIA DeepStream SDK, where pretrained models, TensorRT optimization, and containerized AI Enterprise components detect vehicles and pedestrians, interpret traffic signals, and classify potential hazards. Training runs on NVIDIA DGX A100 systems, while inference is split between NVIDIA Jetson devices at the edge and on-premises servers equipped with NVIDIA T4 and A30 GPUs to balance low-latency roadside processing with centralized multi-stream analytics. The result is a hybrid edge-plus-datacenter architecture that feeds real-time congestion and safety insights to response teams and gives VNPT a reusable base for future AI services.

data_flow: Traffic-camera feeds are processed with Metropolis and DeepStream, edge systems with Jetson interpret signals and track road users, backend T4 and A30 servers aggregate multiple streams, and the resulting alerts and congestion insights are delivered to authorities and response teams.
business_outcome: VNPT reduced model-training time from weeks to days, improved traffic-flow visibility, and built a safer road-monitoring system that can help authorities respond to incidents more quickly and efficiently.
